text: emma-design: small UX nit from today's design review: retention modal shows a KMS badge but it's decorative and the fallback text for region is very low contrast. attaching fig. raj-eng: noted. we default to org region when set; if not, we show 'Fallback: Global'. question: should fallback appear inline or as a tiny pill? pia-copy: microcopy suggestion: label = 'Retention period' hint = 'How long data is kept before deletion.' region line = 'Storage region — Default: Organization setting' and fallback = 'Fallback: Global' (muted). oliver-a11y: Accessibility: make KMS badge focusable (tabindex=0) and provide aria-describedby to an sr-only node. avoid role=img. fallback text needs 4.5:1 contrast or increase weight. keyboard order should be region -> retention -> kms -> help. carol-legal: legal prefers "managed by your KMS" over "stored in" for keys. do not include key ids or arns in tooltips. pete-pm: CSV change: map region_id -> 'Storage region' and policy_id -> 'Retention policy'. add 'Encryption' column with values 'Platform-managed' or 'Customer-managed (KMS region: us-west-2)'. keep phrasing that avoids custody implication. raj-eng: implementation note: ui badge short text = 'Customer-managed'/'Platform-managed'. sr snippet example for devs: Customer-managed Customer-managed encryption key, managed by your KMS, region: us-west-2 pia-copy: small tweak: change tooltip wording to 'Customer-managed encryption key (managed by your KMS, region: us-west-2).' carol ok? carol-legal: that wording is fine. thanks. deploy-bot: staging build 2026-03-22T20:00:01 deployed: https://staging.redwood.ai/console/retention. can a11y test this once up? emma-design: will update figma with the copy and sr-only node, then tag for quick review. thanks!
